checks.invariant: All admin training routes and underlying service entrypoints enforce admin role authorization and validate session_type against SESSION_TYPES

bulk_add_participants and import_trainees enforce session_type role boundaries (_TYPE_ROLES and IMPORT_KINDS), active session status, row caps (50), coder language requirements, and all-or-nothing rollback on dry_run or row refusal

graduate rejects TRN01 and demo projects via _require_graduation_target, maps session roles strictly via _GRADUATION_ROLES (interviewer and coder only), and requires explicit user_id presence in confirm before reactivating accounts or changing cadre

AREA_RULES, may_use_area, resolve_queue, and _training_queue_clause isolate coder (standard set SIDs) from self_coding (own active session units and own submitted drafts) across single and multi-session enrolments

All web intake draft reads, draft saves, draft submissions, submission revisions, and interviewer read-only case views require an active interviewer grant on the draft/submission org_unit_id and respect training_scope isolation
All coding and reviewing assessment write endpoints resolve training_scope for their area and enforce training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid)

_viewer_was_coder_in_session checks MapTrainingParticipant without filtering on active status so removed or former coders cannot view or export reference answer keys even if later promoted to reviewer_data_manager
training_pseudonymiser replaces direct identifiers, shifts linked dates consistently, drops narratives and attachments, and requires manual review approval before import
Non-admin reviewer_data_manager access to trainer reports and CSV exports is restricted to active legacy training sessions where the viewer holds an active participation and grant

candidates.title: Revoked or closed-session trainees and interviewers retain read, save, submit, and revision access via owner-only VaWebIntakeDraft checks
candidates.description: Once a VaWebIntakeDraft row is created while a user has an active interviewer grant, subsequent draft and submission operations in web_intake_service.py authorize solely via draft.user_id == user.user_id without verifying that the user still holds an active interviewer grant on (draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id). First, get_draft, list_drafts, save_draft, and submit_draft omit _require_scope(user, draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id); because close_training_session and remove_participant deactivate VaUserAccessGrants while leaving the training session MasOrgUnit.is_active == True, a trainee whose session S001 was closed or revoked (while remaining enrolled in another active session S002 so may_use_area(user_id, 'intake') passes, or a real-project interviewer whose unit grant was narrowed/revoked while retaining another unit grant) can still read, edit, and submit drafts into the closed/revoked org_unit_id. Second, find_own_submission checks only VaWebIntakeDraft.va_sid == va_sid, VaWebIntakeDraft.user_id == user.user_id, and VaWebIntakeDraft.status == 'submitted', omitting both _require_scope and training_scope.keeps_project; this allows a user whose training session was closed or whose interviewer grant was revoked to create and submit new revisions via revise_submission and to read submitted interview answers via GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace?mode=view and GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/categories/<code>?mode=view.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: app/services/web_intake_service.py#get_draft (lines 1862-1875), list_drafts (lines 1853-1859), save_draft (lines 1878-1905), and submit_draft (lines 2829-3063) rely on draft.user_id == user.user_id and _require_live_org_unit without calling _require_scope(user, draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id), and find_own_submission (lines 3090-3096) checks only VaWebIntakeDraft ownership without calling _require_scope or training_scope.keeps_project.

candidates.title: Reviewer initial and finalize endpoints omit training_scope.resolve('review') and training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid)
candidates.description: In app/routes/api/reviewing.py, all read and allocation endpoints (get_current_allocation, allocate_case, release_allocation, get_stats, get_projects, get_available, get_history) call training_scope.resolve('review'), and allocate_case additionally checks training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid). Likewise, all coder assessment write endpoints in app/routes/api/coding.py (submit_initial_assessment, finalize_cod, mark_not_codeable) call training_scope.resolve('coding') and verify training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid). However, POST /api/v1/reviewing/finalize/<va_sid> and POST /api/v1/reviewing/initial/<va_sid> in app/routes/api/reviewing.py omit both training_scope.resolve('review') and training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid). Because training_scope defaults to 'exclude' when resolve() is not called, requests to these two endpoints ignore ?training=1, skip training_demo_service.may_use_area(current_user.user_id, 'review'), and allow submitting Step 1 and final COD reviews on TRN01 cases without ?training=1 or on production cases even when ?training=1 is passed.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: app/routes/api/reviewing.py#finalize (lines 219-282) and initial (lines 285-343) do not call training_scope.resolve('review') or check training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) before invoking reviewer_coding_service.finalize_review and reviewer_coding_service.submit_initial_assessment.

candidates.title: training_report_service._reviewer_session_ids omits MasTrainingSession.status == 'active', allowing reviewer_data_manager participants of closed sessions to access trainer reports and CSV exports
candidates.description: When an admin closes a training session via close_training_session (app/services/training_demo_service.py:2308-2340), the service sets MasTrainingSession.status = 'closed' and deactivates all participant VaUserAccessGrants while preserving MapTrainingParticipant.status = 'active' so that reopen_training_session can restore grants for non-removed participants. Every other training participation query in training_demo_service.py joins MasTrainingSession and filters on MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'. However, _reviewer_session_ids(viewer_id) in app/services/training_report_service.py:84-100 filters only on MasTrainingSession.session_type.is_(None) and MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active', omitting MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'. Consequently, authorized_session and sessions_for_viewer allow a non-admin user who was a reviewer_data_manager in a closed legacy training session (and who retains the reviewer or data_manager role from any other project or active session to pass @role_required('data_manager', 'reviewer', 'admin')) to continue viewing and exporting the closed session's trainee PII and reference answer keys via /data-management/training/<ref>, /data-management/training/<ref>/coders.csv, and /data-management/training/<ref>/cases.csv.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: app/services/training_report_service.py#_reviewer_session_ids (lines 84-100) omits MasTrainingSession.status == 'active' in its join condition on MasTrainingSession.
